notes.title: House of Moiré - Now Available
notes.notes:
[h3]We are thrilled to announce the official release of House of Moiré! 
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749509/ed581d95a7472017bab1236d4651e1bdd1aa2449.jpg[/img]

An escapist, meditative and abstract atmospheric experience where the user can explore a world outside of our present reality.

This unique XR artwork is conceived by artists Chloe Alexandra Thompson and Matthew Edwards (aesthetic.stalemate), and developed by the international festival MUTEK.

[previewyoutube=pPHDhQcg-mU;full][/previewyoutube]

After being showcased in various exhibitions around the world, at film festivals, music festivals, and digital creativity events, it's now your turn to experience it!

[h3]Share your feedback by leaving a review on the page! And feel free to reach out to us if you encounter any issues or have any questions.
[/h3]

– The MUTEK Team

notes.title: HOUSE OF MOIRÉ OFFICIAL RELEASE DATE: June 30
notes.notes:
[h3]We're back, and after months of waiting, we're ready to open the doors to House of Moiré!
[/h3]
Click on the link below for a preview:

[previewyoutube=SVVlnE5VhA4;full][/previewyoutube]

House of Moiré takes us into a surreal house with multiple rooms, all unique and enigmatic. Can you unravel the sonic and visual mysteries behind each one?

Observe and listen to the whispers emanating from the walls, floors and ceilings. Let yourself be drawn in by the optical patterns. Immerse yourself this shapeshifting world, constantly in motion. 


[h2]Join us at House of Moiré on Friday June 30 at 9:00AM PST for the official release!
[/h2]

notes.title: Trip before the launch
notes.notes:
The second release from our Immersive Collection, [b]House of Moiré[/b] is a Virtual Reality trip into a surreal and psychic realm, where sound objects and moving architecture pave and play your way forward.

We look forward to sharing this experience with you!

[previewyoutube=lOw_yWT6ClU;full][/previewyoutube]

Featuring responsive audiovisual programming and shapeshifting architecture, House of Moiré is a non-game artwork playing with the rules of physics and optical art. Along this curious path, will you discern real from illusory?

[h2]Add House of Moiré to your wishlist, be among the first to unravel the mysteries of its design! [/h2]

[h3]Want to learn more?[/h3]
House of Moiré is based on a live performance by interdisciplinary artists and collaborators Chloe Alexandra Thompson and Matthew Edwards. Chloe is a composer and sound designer interested in the physicality of sound and mediation of technology in installation and performance, and Matthew blends installation art, performance and virtual reality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749509/781fe70176b62605951ec5c5d1e703ecafe794fe.png[/img]

notes.title: First prototype viewing
notes.notes:
These three VR artworks come straight the Festival world. So with MUTEK Festival launching soon, our pre-event conference was the occasion for a few community members to exclusively test out the works, and for the developers and artists to see public reactions for the first time.

notes.title: MUTEK launches the Immersive Collection
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42741267/3ccefa2113836e365ac4f2d048222181acec5cd8.png[/img]
Over the past 23 years, [url=https://montreal.mutek.org/en/immersive-collection]MUTEK[/url] has gained worldwide recognition as a festival presenting cutting-edge audiovisual performances — works that innovate to create a new language of sound and images. [b]MUTEK’s latest project, the Immersive Collection, opens up a new chapter for the organization, marking its first steps as an extended reality (XR) content producer[/b].

[b]Five artists have stepped up to the challenge of reinventing shows previously performed at the festival into an XR artwork[/b]. Each artist was selected due to the acclaim of their original performance, their complementary sources of expertise and their willingness to experiment. The result is an [b]eclectic yet coherent set of three different XR projects[/b] ranging from contemplative to surreal to dynamic: [b][i]Entanglement XR[/i] by France Jobin & Markus Heckmann, [i]House of Moiré[/i] by Chloe Alexandra Thompson & Matthew Edwards (aesthetic.stalemate), and [i]Immortelle[/i] by Line Katcho.[/b]

Not documentary nor classic fiction, not concert nor game, these works [b]defy traditional genres[/b] and define a new category of audiovisual XR experiences that are deployed from original concepts, [b]non-traditional narratives[/b] and advanced digital creation tools. They combine abstract and figurative interpretations, spatialized sound design, radiant visuals and the [b]playful and persevering mindsets of artists venturing into new grounds[/b].

[b]Published by MUTEK[/b] on several online content stores, starting with Steam, the Immersive Collection [b]will also join the catalog of Astrea, the largest international distributor of immersive productions[/b], and be presented at select festivals and spaces worldwide.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42741267/3630db1c7f6604b31e3167f8b218e60c2c5772b5.jpg[/img]
